meta.topic: Digital Arrest Scam: Parents Ko Bachao
meta.title: Digital Arrest Scam: Parents Ko Bachao
meta.fullVoiceover: Video call pe police bole 'tum arrest ho'? Ruko, ye scam hai! Jan se August 2026 me 21 hazaar se zyada complaints, 647 crore ka nuksaan. Fake CBI ya police video call, darate hain, aur paisa transfer karwate hain. Red flag: wo call kaatne aur family ko batane se rokenge. Sach ye hai: India me phone ya video call pe arrest hota hi nahi! Pro tip: call kaato, paisa mat bhejo, aur 1930 pe call karo. Ye reel parents ko bhejo. Follow karo @techwith.GenZ.
meta.instagramCaption:
🚨 Video call pe police bole 'tum arrest ho'? Ruko, ye SCAM hai! Parents ko zaroor dikhao 👇

📊 Jan-Aug 2026: 21,900+ digital arrest complaints, ₹647 crore se zyada ka nuksaan

🎭 Kaise hota hai?
Fake CBI/police/ED officer video call karta hai, 'arrest' ka darr dikhata hai aur paisa transfer karwata hai.

🚩 Red flags:
• Call kaatne se rokenge
• Family ko batane se rokenge
• 'Verification' ke naam pe paisa mangenge

✅ Sach: India me phone ya video call pe arrest nahi hota.

💡 Kya karein:
1️⃣ Call kaat do
2️⃣ Kisi ko paisa mat bhejo
3️⃣ Turant 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint karo

Aapke ghar me kisi ko aisa call aaya hai? Comment me batao 👇
Aur ye reel apne parents ko abhi bhejo 🙏

Follow @techwith.GenZ for daily tech aur safety updates.

⚠️ Disclaimer: Ye reel sirf awareness ke liye hai. Fraud hone par turant official helpline ya apne nazdiki police station se sampark karo.
